Ego's Palace Dining RoomGuardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2Baby tree. Big appetite.Every recipe serves 4.
    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersBaby Groot's twig friesThin sweet potato sticks baked crisp with smoked paprika and saltHow to make it800g sweet potatoes2 tbsp vegetable oil1 tsp smoked paprika1 tsp salt flakesCut the sweet potatoes into thin sticks and toss with oil, paprika and salt.Spread in a single layer on lined trays and bake at 220°C, turning once, until crisp at the edges.Pile into little pots to serve.Sovereign golden saffron aranciniCrumbed saffron risotto balls with mozzarella centres, fried goldenHow to make it300g arborio rice1 L chicken stock, hot1/4 tsp saffron threads50g parmesan, grated150g mozzarella, cubed2 eggs, beaten100g panko breadcrumbs1 L vegetable oil for fryingCook the rice with the hot stock and saffron into a risotto, stir in the parmesan, then spread out to cool.Chill overnight or at least a few hours until firm.Roll into balls around cubes of mozzarella, coat in egg and then panko.Fry in the vegetable oil at 180°C in batches until golden all over.Contraxia mini beef and gravy piesThe Iron Lotus on the pleasure planet ContraxiaHow to make itAs written, serves 4Little shortcrust pies packed with peppery minced beef in thick onion gravy, under golden puff lids, with tomato sauce for dunking.Brown 500g beef mince with 1 diced onion, then stir in 1 tbsp plain flour, 250ml beef stock, 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce and plenty of pepper.Simmer 20 minutes until thick and cool.Cut 12 rounds from 2 shortcrust sheets to line a greased muffin tin, fill with the beef and top with rounds cut from 2 puff sheets.Brush with egg and bake at 200°C for 20 minutes.Serve with tomato sauce.MainsYondu's Ravager stewBeef chuck, carrots and onions simmered 3 hours in stout, with crusty breadHow to make it1kg beef chuck, diced2 brown onions, sliced2 carrots, sliced1 tbsp smoked paprika375ml stout1 loaf of crusty breadBrown the beef in batches in a heavy pot.Add the onions, carrots and paprika and stir for a few minutes.Pour in the stout and enough water to cover.Simmer gently until thick and tender.Serve in big bowls with crusty bread.Ego's garden lemon chicken with farroEgo's beautiful garden planetHow to make itAs written, serves 4Chicken thighs roasted with lemon, garlic and herbs over a big herby farro salad with roast pumpkin, capsicum, feta and pomegranate.Toss 1kg chicken thighs with the zest and juice of 1 lemon, 3 crushed garlic cloves, oregano, olive oil and salt.Roast at 200°C for 35 minutes alongside 500g pumpkin chunks and 1 sliced red capsicum.Simmer 250g farro in salted water for 25 minutes and drain.Toss the farro with the roast veg, parsley, mint, 100g feta, pomegranate seeds and lemon juice and olive oil.Serve the chicken on top.SweetsRavager fireworks popping candy sundaesVanilla ice cream, warm chocolate sauce and popping candy that cracklesHow to make it150ml cream150g dark chocolate, chopped1 L vanilla ice cream2 packets of popping candyHeat the cream until steaming and pour over the chocolate, stirring until smooth.Scoop ice cream into bowls and pour over the warm sauce.Scatter popping candy on top at the table so it crackles.DrinksEgo's garden pear and passionfruit coolerPear nectar, passionfruit, lime and mint over crushed iceHow to make it800ml pear nectar4 passionfruits1 lime1 bunch mint1 L sparkling water1 pear, thinly sliced1 bag crushed iceMix the pear nectar with the passionfruit pulp and lime juice, and bruise the mint through it.Chill for half an hour.Fill glasses with crushed ice, pour in the nectar until three quarters full and top with sparkling water.Garnish with mint sprigs and a pear slice.
